title: Sieve compile errors silently fail-open with no operator alerting
description: smtp/src/session.rs:550-557: when a user's Sieve script has a syntax error, the pipeline logs a warning and falls back to implicit Keep. Mail is delivered normally, the user has no indication their filter is broken, and operators have no dashboard visibility. A user who set a reject rule will never see it fire; they will file a bug. Fix: expose a health endpoint in sieve_admin that lists users with compile-broken scripts, and/or emit a metric counter for sieve_compile_errors_total.
